name: 【 I Am Not A 】Bad Person
source:
A story about deviance, nonsexual sadomasochism, class divides, who we consider evil, and what "choice" means when there are no good choices, set against the backdrop of 1996 Hong Kong.

[From [url=https://theoying.itch.io/bad-person]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个以1996年香港为背景的故事，讲述越轨行为、与性无关的施虐受虐、阶级划分、我们认为邪恶的人，以及在没有好的选择时“选择”意味着什么。

[来自[url=https://theoying.itch.io/bad-person]itch.io[/url]]
